input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a minimal valid JSON schema (e.g., {"type":"object"})

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose meta‑schema version matches the default version and whose root node equals the parsed JSON schema
cases.description: Verifies that a well‑formed JSON schema read from an InputStream is parsed correctly and a JsonSchema object is returned.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a minimal valid YAML schema (e.g., "type: object")

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose root node equals the parsed YAML schema converted to JSON
cases.description: Ensures that when the InputStream contains YAML, the factory detects the format, uses the YAML mapper and returns a proper JsonSchema.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream with zero bytes

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) indicating that the schema content is empty
cases.description: Checks the branch that validates the content length; an empty stream should trigger an exception rather than returning a schema.

input.value: null

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the method does not accept a null stream
cases.description: Validates the defensive check for a null argument at the beginning of the method.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing malformed JSON (e.g., "{type:object")

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating parsing failure
cases.description: Tests the branch where the underlying ObjectMapper fails to parse the content; the method should propagate a parsing exception.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing malformed YAML (e.g., "type: [object")

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) indicating parsing failure
cases.description: Same as above but for YAML detection path.

input.value: InputStream mock that throws IOException on any read operation

cases.expected: IOException propagated from readTree
cases.description: Ensures that an IOException occurring during stream reading is not swallowed and is re‑thrown to the caller.

group: Schema with $id referencing another schema (loader branch)

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with an "$id" field pointing to another schema URI

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose location is resolved via SchemaLoader (non‑null) and whose internal reference map contains the referenced schema
cases.description: Triggers the branch where the factory creates a SchemaLocation, invokes getSchemaLoader(), and resolves external references.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing UTF‑8 BOM (0xEF,0xBB,0xBF) followed by a minimal valid JSON schema: {"type":"object"}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – parsing succeeds despite the leading BOM and the returned schema’s root node equals the parsed JSON object.
cases.description: Verifies that the factory correctly strips a UTF‑8 byte‑order‑mark before parsing the JSON schema.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing whitespace and newline characters before a valid JSON schema, e.g., "\n  \t  {\"type\":\"object\"}"

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – the whitespace is ignored and the schema is parsed correctly.
cases.description: Ensures that leading whitespace and line breaks do not interfere with format detection or parsing.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with an explicit $schema URI for Draft‑07: {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object"}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose meta‑schema version is Draft‑07 (SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V7).
cases.description: Checks that the factory respects the $schema keyword and selects the appropriate meta‑schema version.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with an unknown $schema URI: {"$schema":"http://example.com/unknown/schema#","type":"object"}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) that falls back to the factory’s default meta‑schema version (e.g., Draft‑2019‑09) without throwing an exception.
cases.description: Validates that an unrecognised $schema URI does not cause a failure and that the default meta‑schema is used.

group: Unicode characters in schema property names

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with a Unicode property name: {"type":"object","properties":{"café":{"type":"string"}}}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose parsed root node contains the property name "café" exactly as supplied.
cases.description: Ensures proper UTF‑8 handling for non‑ASCII characters inside the schema.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with an internal $ref: {"$defs":{"addr":{"type":"object","properties":{"street":{"type":"string"}}}},"type":"object","properties":{"address":{"$ref":"#/$defs/addr"}}}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) where the internal reference is resolved – the resulting schema’s "address" property behaves as an object with a "street" string property.
cases.description: Triggers the branch that resolves $ref pointers within the same document.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with duplicate keys: {"type":"object","type":"string"}

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) whose root node’s "type" field equals "string" (the last occurrence wins).
cases.description: Confirms that the underlying Jackson mapper’s default duplicate‑key handling (last‑value wins) does not cause an exception.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a generated JSON schema with 1,000 properties (e.g., {"type":"object","properties":{"p0":{"type":"string"},...,"p999":{"type":"string"}}})

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (non‑null) – the factory successfully reads and parses a large schema without running out of memory or throwing an exception.
cases.description: Tests the method’s ability to handle schemas of considerable size, ensuring stream reading and parsing scale.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing bytes 0xC3 0x28 (invalid UTF‑8) followed by a minimal JSON schema: {"type":"object"}

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonProcessingException) indicating malformed UTF‑8 input
cases.description: Ensures that the factory fails fast when the InputStream contains an illegal UTF‑8 byte sequence, propagating the parsing exception rather than returning a schema.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing plain‑text that is neither valid JSON nor valid YAML (e.g., "Just some random text")

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) stating that the content format could not be detected as JSON or YAML
cases.description: Triggers the branch where format detection fails; the method should throw an exception instead of attempting to parse an unknown format.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with an invalid $id value (e.g., {"$id":"ht!tp://[invalid]","type":"object"})

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) indicating that the $id URI is malformed
cases.description: Verifies that the factory validates the $id field and throws an exception when the URI cannot be parsed.

input.value: InputStream mock that is already closed and throws IOException on any read operation

cases.expected: IOException propagated from the read operation
cases.description: Checks that the method does not swallow an IOException caused by attempting to read from a closed stream.

input.value: ByteArrayInputStream containing a JSON schema with circular $ref (e.g., {"$defs":{"a":{"$ref":"#/$defs/b"},"b":{"$ref":"#/$defs/a"}},"type":"object","properties":{"c":{"$ref":"#/$defs/a"}}})

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or StackOverflowError) indicating that a circular reference was detected
cases.description: Ensures that the factory detects circular $ref loops during schema loading and raises an appropriate exception instead of entering infinite recursion.
